metadata.purpose: Mirror source values, but turn successful empty completion into a lazily created error.

conditions: Every source next is forwarded unchanged.
Successful completion without next invokes one factory and errors; cancellation invokes none.

scope.parameters: Default EmptyError factory binding or a custom synchronous error factory.
scope.callbacks: One explicit invocation at empty completion. Its return/throw is supplied as a correlated outcome; the canonical model never calls it.
scope.time: No clock is introduced. Source events supply time; input order breaks equal-time ties. Callers must supply synchronous callback outcomes at the invocation time; generic runTrace does not enforce that envelope-time precondition.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions; synchronous callback outcomes are explicit microsteps. Ordered source teardown assumes source setup has returned.
exclusions: Concrete EmptyError prototype construction is checked natively; the model treats the valid default-factory outcome as an opaque object.
An outcome attributed to the default binding is assumed to come from that pinned constructor, not an arbitrary substituted factory.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: No connection during construction. The first result subscription applies the profile-specific acquisition rule.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay. Each result subscription owns its memory and resource generations; supplied producers may themselves be shared.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Return from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.
Throw from the currently pending, correlated synchronous callback.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Listening.
See the typed state and named transitions for CreatingError.
Terminated; no owned subscriptions or retained values.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.explanation: Emptiness is assessed separately for each subscription.

rules.nextState: Listening with hasValue=true, including when the value is undefined.
rules.explanation: The presence bit, not the payload, establishes nonemptiness.

rules.guard: at least one value has arrived
rules.nextState: Closed complete; never invoke the factory.
rules.explanation: A nonempty source is mirrored without manufacturing an extra value.

actions: invoke the selected error factory once
rules.nextState: CreatingError; waiting only for its correlated synchronous outcome.
rules.explanation: The factory is called at empty completion, not at construction, source failure, or cancellation.

rules.guard: outcome belongs to errorFactory invocation zero
actions: error with the exact returned value
rules.explanation: Returned values are error-channel payloads, not next values. The default binding supplies a fresh EmptyError instance.

rules.guard: outcome belongs to errorFactory invocation zero
actions: forward the exact thrown value as error
rules.explanation: A throwing custom factory is intercepted by the operator subscriber.

rules.guard: source fails, regardless of value presence
rules.explanation: Source failure is not empty successful completion.
A cancelled empty subscription is not an EmptyError.
